title: ExoPath-GNN: a leakage-controlled, shift-aware framework for externally validated colon-cancer survival triage
description:
Reference implementation and reproducibility scaffold for ExoPath-GNN, a prospective, leakage-controlled and shift-aware protocol for multimodal colon-cancer survival triage.

The release contains deterministic patient-level split tooling, a versioned typed-graph schema, censoring-aware survival utilities, budget-matched protocol heads, shift and abstention checks, a locked-output reporting contract, configuration and provenance specifications, unit tests, and a standard-library-only synthetic dry run.

Important: the manuscript reports a planned analysis. This archive contains no participant-level TCGA, PLCO or PAIP data, no cohort-derived model weights, and no measured evidence of clinical performance, transportability or quantum advantage. The synthetic example tests software contracts only.
